protocol.forecast: Shallow histogram trees: 80 iterations, 4 leaves, min leaf 60, L2 10, learning rate .05; no early stopping
protocol.forecast_inputs: Ten original Coinbase features; no Kalshi prices
protocol.gate: Standardized ridge alpha=100 on realized YES/NO per-contract net returns from chronological out-of-fold forecasts
protocol.gate_training: First 40% of training dates warmup; three expanding blocks of remaining dates, two-hour embargo
protocol.execution: Recomputed next-minute inputs; assumed fills with 2-cent slippage and .07 quadratic fees
protocol.selection: Fixed experiment; no parameter grid or original test access
limitations: Gate return estimates are not confidence bounds
Shift from original training to next-minute horizon

uncertainty.note: Exploratory day-block ratios including no-trade days; undefined zero-trade ratios excluded. Fixed historical fills, not a policy replay or reliable six-day edge test.
